description: This file defines a Java interface 'ProductImageRemove' for managing product images within a CMS module, extending 'ImageRemove' and declaring methods for removing product images.

classes.name: ProductImageRemove
classes.description: An interface extending ImageRemove, declaring methods for removing individual or multiple product images.

methods.name: removeProductImage
methods.description: Removes a single product image, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes images associated with a given product, potentially throwing a ServiceException.
